title: Functorial cycle-pullback construction from an epimorphic cover
statement: Let $A$ be an abelian category and $S$ a property of its objects containing every zero object. Suppose given $T:A\to A$ and $\pi:T\to\operatorname{Id}_A$ with $S(T(X))$ and epic $\pi_X$ for every $X$. For any integer $N$, on the full subcategory of cochain complexes [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] vanishing above $N$, there are a functor $Q$ and a natural augmentation $\epsilon:Q\to\iota$, with $S((QF)^i)$ and $(QF)^i=0$ for $i>N$. For every object $B$, degree $i$, cycle $x:B\to (QF)^{i+1}$ and map $y:B\to F^i$ satisfying $\epsilon^{i+1}x=d_F^i y$, there exist an epimorphism $p:B^{\prime}\to B$ and $z:B^{\prime}\to(QF)^i$ with $\epsilon^i z=yp$ and $d_{QF}^i z=xp$.

source.place: Lemma 05T7 (1), descending cycle-pullback induction; functoriality from fixed functorial covers as in 03EW

proof.text: Apply the non-epimorphic structural construction to obtain Q and epsilon, the term property, the bound and identifications of terms at or below N with T of the next cycle-pullback. This uses hzero and hT but not hpi.

For i at or below N, form e as the identification isomorphism followed by the cover pi of the cycle-pullback. The hypothesis hpi and the isomorphism make e epic. Rewrite the structural projection equations using associativity and apply the proved local lifting theorem to x,y. For i>N, both y and x have zero targets by the respective bounds, hence vanish; take B prime=B, p=identity, z=zero. Combine these cases with the term and bound properties.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_functorial_cyclePullback_construction
    {A : Type u} [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A] (S : ObjectProperty A)
    (hzero : ∀ X : A, IsZero X → S X)
    (T : A ⥤ A) (π : T ⟶ 𝟭 A)
    (hT : ∀ X : A, S (T.obj X)) (hπ : ∀ X : A, Epi (π.app X)) (N : ℤ) :
    let P : ObjectProperty (CochainComplex A ℤ) :=
      fun F ↦ ∀ i : ℤ, N < i → IsZero (F.X i)
    ∃ Q : P.FullSubcategory ⥤ CochainComplex A ℤ,
      ∃ ε : Q ⟶ P.ι, ∀ F : P.FullSubcategory,
        (∀ i : ℤ, S ((Q.obj F).X i)) ∧
        (∀ i : ℤ, N < i → IsZero ((Q.obj F).X i)) ∧
        ∀ (i : ℤ) (B : A) (x : B ⟶ (Q.obj F).X (i + 1))
          (y : B ⟶ F.obj.X i),
          x ≫ (Q.obj F).d (i + 1) (i + 1 + 1) = 0 →
          x ≫ (ε.app F).f (i + 1) = y ≫ F.obj.d i (i + 1) →
          ∃ (B' : A) (p : B' ⟶ B) (_ : Epi p) (z : B' ⟶ (Q.obj F).X i),
            z ≫ (ε.app F).f i = p ≫ y ∧
              z ≫ (Q.obj F).d i (i + 1) = p ≫ x
